## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> List activity on the user's Substack (same rules as the WriteStack activity feed): non-dismissed items, excluding the user's own author, optional filter (all / comments / mentions). Results are deduped by thread, include ancestor rows when needed, and each item includes merged attachments plus reaction/restack/comment counts. Use skip and limit for pagination (max 50 per page). totalDeduped is the thread count before slicing; hasMore indicates more pages.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | `string` | No | Filter activities: all, comments, or mentions One of: `"all"`, `"comments"`, `"mentions"`. Default `"all"`. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Max activities to return (default 20, max 50) Default `15`. |
| `skip` | `number` | No | Offset for pagination Default `0`. |
